node.statement: Applying lem-routef-degree-two-estimate at n=q with X=I and the present Y, and using Delta_q(I)=I, gives ||Phi_q(Delta_q(Y))-Delta_q(Y)||<=C_2*eta*||Y||. Contractivity of Phi_q and Delta_q and ||hat-U_js||=||hat-U_jt^*||=1 therefore imply ||A_st-Phi_q(Delta_q(hat-U_js)Delta_q(Y)Delta_q(hat-U_jt^*))||<=C_2*eta*||Y||.
